sentences.l2: Leo plays soccer with his friends every week.
sentences.l1: 利奥每周都和朋友们踢足球。

sentences.l2: Sometimes, kids fall down and get small injuries when they run fast.
sentences.l1: 有时候,孩子们跑得快就会摔倒,受一些小伤。

sentences.l2: To help, Leo has a special red box called a first aid kit.
sentences.l1: 为了帮忙,利奥有一个叫急救包的特别的红色盒子。

sentences.l2: He keeps it in his sports bag.
Inside the kit, there are clean bandages to stop blood and cold packs to make a bumped knee feel better.
sentences.l1: 急救包里有止血的干净绷带,还有能让磕到的膝盖舒服些的冷敷袋。

sentences.l2: Leo brings this kit to every game so he can help his team stay safe and happy.
sentences.l1: 利奥每场比赛都带着这个急救包,这样他就能帮助他的队伍保持安全和快乐。
